content.title: Sunday delivery date is unavailable during guest checkout on a phone
content.intent: Prove that the delivery-date control in the phone-sized guest checkout flow forbids selecting a Sunday.
content.technique_notes: Derived from covering_array strength=3 over surface × checkout_mode × delivery_date because money risk applied; the tool returned two unique combinations and this scenario covers the Sunday-forbidden combination. Applied negative and web-form techniques because the source stated a specific forbidden date choice rather than an alternate successful outcome. dedupe_candidates found no duplicate candidate, and graph_search_similar_batch found no existing scenario-level reuse candidate.
